name: Dain Schwab
prior_offices: Lincoln County coroner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Dain Schwab is the Lincoln County coroner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official coroner page lists him in that office. SVI-NEWS reported that his race was decided in the Republican primary and that he was unopposed in the general election.

sources.name: SVI-NEWS, Nov. 3, 2026, 2026 Lincoln County General Election Results
